message:
Keep MCP callable names stable across binding hydration (#3738) (#3751)

Fixes #3738. When a remote agent's bare durable ID hydrates into its
display name, repeating an issued tool name and identical arguments
currently fails with `no_binding`, although the binding and target have
not changed.

Assign agent/group callable keys when the actual binding is created and
retain them across metadata updates and persisted rebuilds. A
cryptographic process incarnation plus bounded generation separates
replacement wires and process restarts, including reversed binding
order. Removed wires never become aliases for replacement targets.
Current caller, wire-switch, grant and host checks remain authoritative.

Bound readable prefixes and publish current, JSON-quoted, sanitized
Target display name/project/address data in tool descriptions. Listing
and guidance preview use one formatter, preserving exact preview/list
equality. This modest prompt-text surface is data, not instructions or
authorization; it includes no private path/configuration fields.

E2E consumers select exactly one current tool by full Target ID and
suffix. After an actual app crash/restart, the Annex test proves the
retired name is refused without requests, receiver inputs or receipt
changes, then rediscovers the same endpoint's current name. Original
arguments/idempotency, strict receipt SHA, file bytes/replay, delivery
request counts and single-delivery assertions remain intact.

Exact reviewed source: `c0a278d6e96484394cda8b595a90e32da2af9a12`.

- Core/preview parent `0723c341045212306c3966f6b8951b626d95e10f`: 633
passed across 14 affected/importer suites; full production TypeScript
check passed; lint passed with eight retained warnings. Final source has
an identical `src` tree.
- Final five-file test-only delta: 12 pure-selector tests passed; scoped
E2E type graph passed; lint passed with zero errors and six retained
warnings. The ad hoc test-only type config uses ES2022/DOM declarations
for Node 22. Its initial ES2020 attempt and prior-source comparison
reproduce four existing API-library diagnostics; no production compiler
option or diagnostic suppression changed.
- Hydration/restart baseline RED and restoring mutations are preserved,
including wrong-target forwarding when the process namespace is removed.
Current permission/removal/replacement, target isolation, entropy
failure, counter exhaustion and real template name-budget controls
remain intact.
- Independent QA approved the complete `807360c54 → 0723c3410 →
c0a278d6e` stack in [report
`4f2175d63`](https://github.com/Agent-Clubhouse/Clubhouse/commit/4f2175d637b69728c7038e56c8eeb27b33e04d61).

Sealed evidence, with raw receipts, exact commands, pre/post hashes and
committed manifests:

- [Original identity proof
`7e362e2cc`](https://github.com/Agent-Clubhouse/Clubhouse/tree/7e362e2cc1f0ea153a5569dad86ec5cfedc00a0d/docs/evidence/mcp-stable-binding-name).
- [Preview correction and original hosted failures

- [Exact-target E2E consumer proof
`e86254490`](https://github.com/Agent-Clubhouse/Clubhouse/tree/e86254490b5860c431ed41936352d254b6ac543e/docs/evidence/mcp-stable-binding-e2e-consumers).

Original hosted run
[44876043424](https://github.com/Agent-Clubhouse/Clubhouse/actions/runs/44876043424)
is retained as FAILURE: it exposed the corrected preview/consumer
assumptions. Exact JUnit/Playwright archives and GitHub artifact digests
are preserved. Its separate Windows managed-agent test timeout remains
unresolved, is not claimed fixed or classified as infrastructure, and
must be investigated if it recurs. No blind retry or waiver was used.

Ordinary hosted validation on the updated reviewed head remains
required; no local E2E was run. macOS remains under the existing
maintainer pause. No P8 draft/threshold changes, old-namespace
acceptance, federation-review changes, live probes/settings/access
changes, restarts, installs or releases are included. This PR does not
establish broader live P8 acceptance. The parent orchestrator owns the
final guarded merge after green.
